Figma OS · Leila's CPU

Puts the gate-level CPU and its Live view into the live OS's CPU tab. Nothing is rebuilt.
Run the "Figma OS · CPU + Learn" extension first: this goes in its CPU tab, and has to be added again after that one is. In Present, the CPU tab shows the Live view: Step runs one chunk of a clock tick, Run plays to HALT, the program buttons load a program. "OS chip ›" switches back to the OS's own CPU page. Remove takes out everything this added.
